rows.title: Analytics Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About Swap

Swap is the infrastructure behind modern agentic commerce. The only AI-native platform connecting backend operations with a forward-thinking storefront experience.

Built for brands that want to sell anything - anywhere, Swap centralises global operations, powers intelligent workflows, and unlocks margin-protecting decisions with real-time data and capability. Our products span cross-border, tax, returns, demand planning, and our next-generation agentic storefront, giving merchants full transparency and the ability to act with confidence.

At Swap, we’re building a culture that values clarity, creativity, and shared ownership as we redefine how global commerce works.

About The Role

We're looking for a passionate and pragmatic Analytics Engineer to join our Analytics Engineering team, helping to scale our stack for a new data-driven era at Swap.

This is an important contributor role within the team, offering a good degree of ownership and the chance to help build a scalable, modern data architecture. You’ll build and maintain the data models that power our entire business—from internal commercial insights for Sales and Finance to the trusted data sets enabling customer-facing agentic systems.

We need a hands-on builder excited to contribute to our high-quality dbt project, help shape our analytics vision, and support the scaling of our models as we grow. If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative team with high ownership and impact, we'd love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

dbt Development: Scale our dbt project, shaping its architecture and CI/CD processes to support company-wide initiatives. Data Modelling & Architecture: Contribute to our data modelling strategy, helping to build and maintain the core set of performant, scalable, and trusted data models that power all downstream consumers—from our internal BI tool to our customer-facing agentic systems and analytics APIs. Data Quality & Governance: Champion and implement robust data quality standards, PII governance, testing, and documentation to ensure our data is trustworthy and reliable as we scale. Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with commercial (Sales, Finance) and product teams on data needs, assisting in translating business questions into data requirements and helping to manage delivery expectations. BI & Self-Service Enablement: Contribute to the development and refinement of foundational data assets in our BI tool (Lightdash), helping stakeholders and analysts access insights effectively. 

What We Would Like To See

Solid experience in a data-focused role such as Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or BI Development, or equivalent academic experience. Hands-on experience with dbt (dbt Core/Cloud). Strong proficiency in SQL and good understanding of data modelling patterns. Experience with a modern cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery etc). Experience with version control using Git. Good communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A detail-oriented mindset with a willingness to learn and contribute to building trustworthy data products. 

Diversity & Equal Opportunities:

We embrace diversity and equality in a serious way. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills, and views. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. Creating a culture of equality isn't just the right thing to do; it's also the smart thing.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

The Data Analyst builds and maintains the business-facing layer of HeartFlow’s data platform — analytical applications, the reporting and visualization architecture, and the semantic model definitions that serve them. This is a hands-on technical role combining application development with business intelligence architecture: work product includes code that is version controlled, peer reviewed, and deployed through continuous integration, as well as the dashboards, reports, and interfaces through which the business consumes it.

The role builds on data warehoused in Amazon Redshift, contributing to the semantic model, the reporting and visualization architecture, analytical applications, and the data quality validation and access governance around them. You will work directly with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Production, Compliance, Customer Success, and Medical Education, translating business questions into engineered, reusable data products rather than one-off deliverables.

The role spans both engineering and business fluency. The same person who writes the application code is expected to sit with the stakeholder who will use it, understand the decision it supports, and stay with it through adoption and iteration. Work ranges from a governed dashboard consumed by sales leadership to a purpose-built application that replaces a manual process outright.

Job Responsibilities:

Analytical Application Development: Design, build, and maintain business-facing analytical applications and interfaces using Python and JavaScript. Own the development lifecycle including requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.Business Intelligence & Reporting: Develop and maintain the business-facing reporting and visualization layer within Tableau — calculated field and parameter logic, dashboard design, and publishing and permissions management — building on the data sources and extract strategy designed by the Analytics Engineering function. Design dynamic and fluid visualizations for a wide range of stakeholder groups across all user levels, and create relevant measures and KPIs covering commercial performance, business performance indicators, pipeline management, and ad hoc strategic initiatives.Semantic Model Development: Author and extend Cube semantic model definitions as version-controlled code, submitted through pull request review. Implement measures, dimensions, and views consistent with the function’s modeling conventions so that business metric definitions remain centrally governed and consistently consumed.CRM Data & Reporting: Design and maintain advanced reporting and analysis on Salesforce.com (SFDC) data, applying working knowledge of SFDC reporting structure, object-field relationships, and the varied dynamics of the system. Support business users in the effective use of CRM reporting.Engineering Practice: Work within the function’s engineering operating model: Git-based version control, branching strategy, pull request authorship and review, branch protection, and CI/CD through GitHub Actions. Participate in code review as both author and reviewer.Data Quality & Stewardship: Analyze and curate varied sources of data to address key business priorities. Maintain strong data integrity including routine QC and validation across the reporting and semantic suite, contribute to automated testing and data quality validation, and identify and escalate data defects in CRM and other source data consumed by function-owned systems.Data Governance: Administer role-based access control and row-level security for function-owned reporting and application assets in accordance with company data handling policy.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with wide-ranging cross-functional teams including sales and sales leadership, operations, customer success, marketing, finance, compliance, and medical education to facilitate data-driven decisions.Ad Hoc Projects: Utilize classic SDLC and Agile processes to plan, manage, and execute ad hoc initiatives supporting various stakeholder groups.

Skills Needed:

Required:

Strong SQL, including the ability to write, optimize, and reason about queries against a cloud data warehouse and a semantic layer.Demonstrated experience writing and maintaining production code in Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language — including application development, not solely scripting or notebook work.Proven experience with full cycle dashboard development in Tableau, including calculated fields, parameters, dashboard design, and publishing and permissions, working against data sources designed by others.Strong grasp of variable and function-based calculations and the ability to design custom and dynamic metrics to shape and create various KPIs.Working knowledge of Salesforce.com (SFDC) reporting structure, object-field relationships, and the varied dynamics of the system.Git-based development workflow: branching, pull request authorship and review, and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent).Experience creating dynamic and fluid modeling and visualizations for a wide range of stakeholder groups across all user levels.Excellent communication and presentation skills appropriate to the level of audience, including the ability to elicit requirements from non-technical stakeholders.Ability to be extremely agile and deadline focused with a high degree of quality.Natural problem solver.

Preferred:

Familiarity with semantic modeling layers implemented as code (Cube, dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, or equivalent).Cloud data warehouse experience (Amazon Redshift or equivalent) as a consumer and modeler of warehoused data.Understanding of data access governance concepts, including role-based access control and row-level security.Data quality and validation practice, including QC methodology and automated testing concepts.Fundamental knowledge of object-oriented programming.Understanding of healthcare technology and commercialization.

Educational Requirements & Work Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.2+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or software development, including hands-on development work.Experience with Tableau or equivalent BI software and Salesforce.com (SFDC).Demonstrated experience writing and maintaining code in Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language.Experience working within a version-controlled development workflow and a formal code review process.Experience creating custom variable-based logic functions.Experience with semantic modeling layers implemented as code a plus.Experience with curating, modeling, and handling large-scale data sets a plus.Healthcare, medical device, or other regulated industry experience a plus.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary compensation range is $110,000 to $140,000, and bonus.

Heartflow is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at Heartflow, including recruitment, hiring, training, relocation, promotion, and termination.

Positions posted for Heartflow are not intended for or open to third party recruiters / agencies. Submission of any unsolicited resumes for these positions will be considered to be free referrals.

Before providing any personal information to outside parties, please verify the following: A) all legitimate Heartflow recruiter email addresses end with “@heartflow.com” and B) the position described is found on our careers site at www.heartflow.com/about/careers/.

rows.descriptionText:
Operations & Impact Analyst (AI-Native)
The Opportunity:We are an investing organization funding solutions to humanity's most pressing challenges. This has led us to focus on the inter-related areas of planet, equity, health, and poverty while also accelerating essential market infrastructure. Our dynamic approach spans diverse geographies, asset classes, structures and stages - optimizing our ability to create transformative positive impact where it is most needed.
Our investment work is a mandate of a single family office and covers all aspects of strategy, sourcing, underwriting and asset management. We are a growing team of experienced and passionate mission-aligned investment and operational professionals, advisors, and consultants.
In this phase of our organization, we're focused on accelerating our mission, building a world-class and agile team, forging trust-based partnerships with industry-leading experts, identifying high-conviction investment opportunities, and deploying capital thoughtfully.
Position Overview: As part of our planned growth, we are seeking a highly organized Operations & Impact Analyst (AI-Native) to sit at the center of a seven-person investment team deploying impact-first capital globally. This role provides real proximity to how capital allocation decisions actually get made.
This is the entry point to our operations track, focused deeply on platform management, process automation, and executive administration. Please note: investment execution (subscription docs, capital calls, etc), investment analysis and financial modeling are not part of this role and are not the primary route onwards. Our generous professional development budget deliberately supports building this operations track.
Key Responsibilities:
AI & Process ImprovementTake primary ownership of integrating AI skills and agents into manual team workflows.Test new AI capabilities, identify recurring manual friction, and build recommended automation fixes.Ensure AI-enabled workflows meet appropriate cyber and data security standards.
Investment Operations & DataMaintain pipeline and deal records to a high standard, keeping our platforms trustworthy as the ultimate source of record.Support ongoing portfolio tracking by maintaining key updates, milestones, and data used for team reporting and portfolio management.Submit and track routine investment, budget, and legal approvals through the team's technology platforms.Produce the weekly investment digest and prepare pipeline material for our weekly newsletter.Drive the NDA and NRL process with counterparties and track legal execution status.Maintain partner records.
Executive Administration & LogisticsManage calendar scheduling for specified team members, resolving conflicts and protecting time against low-value demands.Coordinate end-to-end travel, including complex itineraries and site visits, and prepare and submit monthly expenses.Manage logistics for standing meetings, offsites, and other team events.Prepare and circulate pre-reads and capture post-meeting follow-ups and outputs.Support vendor and consultant relationships and operational coordination with internal accounting, legal, and other critical stakeholders.
Core Competencies:Artificial Intelligence (AI) ; Operations Management ; Executive Administrative Assistance ; Process Automation ; Data Management ; Calendar Management ; Workflow Automation ; Project Management ; Philanthropy ; Venture Philanthropy
Qualifications:At least 2-4 years of relevant experience with an emerging competency profile focused on operational execution.We are open to people from a variety of backgrounds with transferable skills and a strongly shared mission.A passionate alignment of personal values with the firm's mission, embodying our five core values: Kind, Humble, Brave, Committed, and Continuous Learning.Adept at navigating platforms, document stores, and AI toolsets.Willingness to debate, engage in dialogue, and proactively escalate when something seems wrong, including upward.Versatile and adaptable, with strong time prioritization to allocate focus to the highest-impact work.
Salary and Benefits: The starting base salary range for this position, based in Palo Alto, is between $140,000 – $160,000 USD annually, plus a discretionary bonus. Industry-competitive compensation and benefits include an extremely attractive package:Paid health plans for employee plus qualified dependents401k matchProfessional development budget for qualified tuition reimbursement529 plan matchingCharitable giving matchingHealth & wellness program budgetHealthcare flexible spending & fertility plan

rows.title: Associate Trade Marketing Manager - National Accounts
rows.descriptionText:
Req ID: 7091

Department: Sales

Status: Reg F-T Exempt, Exempt

Location: Napa, California (US-CA)

Workplace Location: Hybrid

About Trinchero Family Estates

Trinchero Family Estates is one of the largest family-owned wine and spirits companies in the United States, with an award-winning portfolio of brands enjoyed by consumers around the world. For more than 75 years, we have combined entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a passion for quality to create brands that connect with consumers and drive growth across every channel of the beverage industry.

Position Summary

The Associate Trade Marketing Manager, National Accounts plays a key role in driving growth across some of the nation's most influential restaurant, hotel, entertainment, and hospitality partners.

This highly collaborative position sits at the intersection of sales, marketing, consumer insights, and creative development. The role is responsible for creating compelling customer presentations, developing impactful marketing programs, supporting national account activations, and uncovering growth opportunities that enhance the performance of Trinchero Family Estates brands with National Account Customers.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative and analytical marketer who enjoys transforming insights into action, developing persuasive business stories, and contributing to strategic customer growth initiatives.

 Why This Role Matters 

In This Role, You Will

 Partner directly with National Accounts sales leaders to help win new business and expand existing customer partnerships.  Influence marketing strategies for leading restaurant, hospitality, entertainment, and foodservice operators.  Collaborate with brand marketing, innovation, creative services, digital marketing, trade marketing, and sales teams across the organization.  Bring consumer insights and market trends to life through compelling, customer-focused storytelling.  Support national account activations and programs that create measurable business impact.  Gain exposure to senior leadership, strategic planning, and commercial decision-making. 

Key Responsibilities

 Strategic Sales & Marketing Support 

 Develop compelling customer presentations, RFP responses, and business reviews that support account growth and brand placement opportunities.  Translate customer objectives, consumer insights, and market trends into persuasive business recommendations.  Collaborate with National Accounts sales teams to identify opportunities that support customer goals and drive profitable growth.  Support the development and execution of strategic marketing initiatives for key national account partners. 

 Customer Storytelling & Content Development 

 Create impactful presentations and sales tools that communicate the value of Trinchero Family Estates brands and portfolio solutions.  Develop customer-specific content that aligns with each account's unique business objectives and consumer audience.  Write compelling copy and messaging that supports product placements, promotional initiatives, and customer engagement.  Research industry, consumer, and competitive trends to strengthen customer recommendations and business proposals. 

 Insights & Business Analytics 

 Utilize available market data, consumer insights, and analytics tools to support strategic recommendations.  Identify emerging beverage and hospitality trends that can translate into business opportunities for key accounts.  Transform data and insights into clear, actionable recommendations that support customer growth and brand performance. 

 Marketing Programs & Activations 

 Support the development and execution of customer marketing programs designed to drive awareness, trial, and sales.  Coordinate national account activations and ensure successful execution across internal and external stakeholders.  Assist in planning and executing trade shows, customer events, and industry conferences.  Develop post-program recaps and reporting to evaluate performance and identify future opportunities. 

 Creative Development & Brand Stewardship 

 Create visually engaging presentations and marketing materials utilizing PowerPoint, Adobe Creative Suite, AI-enabled tools, and other content creation platforms.  Partner closely with Creative Services and Brand Marketing teams to ensure consistency of brand standards and messaging.  Maintain a high standard of visual storytelling and presentation excellence across all customer-facing materials. 

 Cross-Functional Collaboration 

 Build strong working relationships across Sales, Marketing, Creative Services, Insights, Innovation, and Operations teams.  Support special projects and strategic initiatives for National Accounts leadership.  Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability in managing multiple projects and competing priorities. 

Qualifications

 Required 

 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.  2+ years of experience in marketing, customer marketing, sales enablement, trade marketing, category management, hospitality, CPG, beverage alcohol, agency, or related industries.  Strong presentation development and visual storytelling skills.  Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.  Strong project management and organizational abilities.  Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.  Proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and other business productivity tools. 

Preferred

 Experience supporting B2B sales teams or customer-facing marketing initiatives.  Knowledge of hospitality, foodservice, wine, spirits, or consumer packaged goods industries.  Experience using data and consumer insights to support business recommendations.  Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite or other design platforms.  Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, content development, and presentation creation. 

What Will Make You Successful

You are someone who:

 Combines creativity with analytical thinking.  Enjoys transforming ideas and insights into compelling business stories.  Is energized by a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.  Has a passion for consumer trends, hospitality, food, beverage, and brand building.  Takes initiative and embraces ownership.  Thrives in a collaborative team environment.  Maintains exceptional attention to detail while balancing multiple priorities.  Is curious, resourceful, and always looking for better ways to drive results. 

 Career Growth Opportunity 

This role provides exposure to multiple areas of the business and can serve as a foundation for future opportunities in:

 Brand Marketing  Customer Marketing  National Account Marketing  Trade Marketing  Commercial Strategy  Consumer Insights  Sales Leadership 

If you're looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact, develop strategic marketing skills, and help shape growth for an industry-leading portfolio of brands, we'd love to hear from you.

Salary Range: $70,000.00 - $90,000.00

The starting pay will be based on several factors, including but not limited to experience, training, education, and geographic location. TFE offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, PTO, wellness programs and fertility and family building benefits. We also provide a 401(k) plan where TFE may make a discretionary profit-sharing contribution.

Trinchero Family Estates provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Trinchero Family Estates complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Who We Are

Voxel is building the future of Computer Vision and Machine Learning for operations, risk, and safety. We use computer vision and AI to enable existing security cameras to automatically detect hazards and high-risk activities, keep people safe and drive operational efficiencies. Our technology addresses the key cost drivers for workers’ compensation, general liability, and property damage, which cost US employers over $500 billion annually.

What You'll Do

We are seeking a highly motivated and bright engineer to join our team and devise elegant solutions to challenging problems. This role will focus on designing and implementing systems to support Voxel's ML development. As a part of the perception team, you should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and solving problems across the software stack. We require engineers to be versatile and possess the ability to move across projects and tackle new challenges.

Develop and productionize state-of-the-art computer vision algorithms for object detection, tracking, pose estimation, activity recognition, and anomaly detection in complex indoor environments like warehouses and retail spaces.Implement and optimize computer vision techniques for high-throughput, low-latency applications on edge compute devices.Streamline ML data ingestion, retraining pipelines, and model redeployment workflows.Build and maintain reliable, scalable pipelines for continuous training and deployment of ML models in production environments.Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Field Engineering to architect ML-driven solutions tailored to customer needs and deployment contexts.

Qualifications

Must-Haves

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics or a related field.Software development experience with proficiency in Python, Go-Lang or C++.Ability to solve complex and open-ended problemsFamiliarity with version control systems like Git (e.g., branching, merging, pull requests).

Why Join Us?

Join a visionary team revolutionizing safety and operations, directly impacting the well-being of millions of essential workers. This is your chance to build an extraordinary business and foster a vibrant company culture that demands your absolute best. Alongside AI experts, experienced entrepreneurs, and passionate problem-solvers, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the company's growth trajectory and market position. Enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and a dynamic work environment.

rows.title: Sr. Data Scientist, Monetization
rows.descriptionText:
About Pinterest

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

We are looking for Data Scientists to join our Monetization Engineering organization. You will take end to end ownership of designing, researching, building, and delivering data products as well as collaborate with XFNs to formulate, experiment, and evolve Pinterest’s strategy in the Ads space.

What You’ll Do

Deep strategic analysis to answer core questions such as: How do we assess the trade-off between metrics change? How should we evaluate overall impact from changes in one component of the ads ecosystem?Opportunity sizing and analysis. Should Pinterest adjust programmatic ad load based on ? Write clear, actionable analyses that help teams identify areas of improvement and investment.Modeling: Build segmentation models to assess supply to inform pricing strategy.Improve decision velocity and quality using data scientist tool kit: experimentation, causal inference techniques, etc. Design measurement strategy, advise on experimentation best practices, identifying flaws in experiment practices and results; building tools for experiment analysis etc.Creating and tracking success metrics. Identify the right measures of success for engineering teams and help them track those metrics. Break down high-level metrics into actionable segments. This work may span from collecting entirely new datasets to building dashboards to track components of a metric (e.g., monitoring conversion data for missing values, implausible values, duplicated data, etc. by advertiser over time).Leadership: Lead and mentor the scope of work for data scientists in the same area, demonstrating high-quality output of both yourself and others for whom you are responsible. Provide continuous and candid feedback, recognizing individual strengths and contributions and flagging opportunities to improve performance.


What We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Data Science, or equivalent experience5+ years of combined post-graduate academic and industry experience applying scientific methods to solve real-world problems on web-scale data.Strong fundamentals in statistics, experimentation.Domain knowledge in ecosystem, ads, or real-time-bidding.Proven ability to apply scientific methods to solve real-world problems on web-scale data.Proficiency in SQL/Hive/Python.

This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

rows.title: Sr. Networking Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Summary

We are seeking a senior-level Network Security Subject Matter Expert with a strong cybersecurity mindset to support the design, configuration, and implementation of Zero Trust networking, starting with VPN access using Palo Alto Networks technologies.

This role is initially focused on transforming our VPN environment from a traditional network-based model to an identity- and role-based Zero Trust access model. The ideal candidate is hands-on, security-focused, and comfortable working closely with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams in a regulated, audit-conscious environment. This is a consulting role and will be payrolled through our third party vendor.

Key Responsibilities

Zero Trust & VPN Engineering

Design and configure Palo Alto Networks VPN solutions to support Zero Trust principlesImplement least-privilege VPN access, where users can only access systems required for their roleDefine and enforce user- and group-based access policies rather than broad network accessPartner with cybersecurity leadership to align VPN controls with Zero Trust strategy

Network Security & Visibility

Support network segmentation and secure access to sensitive systems (e.g., admin and infrastructure services)Ensure configurations are fully auditable and defensible for future compliance reviews

Forensics & Access Context

Use AlienVault and Palo Alto to:Analyze VPN traffic and user activityIdentify systems and applications accessed by ~ 100 VPN users for this engagementSupport forensic investigations related to VPN accessProvide actionable insights to help:Build a VPN access context based on VPN traffic analysis of the 100 usersAssign users to the correct VPN groups as part of the Zero Trust initiative
Collaboration & Communication

Work closely with:The IT Architecture teamThe Cybersecurity teamClearly communicate technical findings, access models, and design decisionsParticipate in design reviews, scoping discussions, and implementation planning
Required Qualifications

U.S. CitizenAbility to work onsite in San Jose, CASenior-level experience in network security engineeringStrong hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls and VPNDemonstrated understanding of Zero Trust networking conceptsExperience implementing identity-based and role-based access controlsHands-on experience with utilizing SIEM (AlienVault preferred) for logging, analysis, and forensic investigationsStrong troubleshooting and analytical skillsAbility to communicate effectively with highly technical teams

To apply for this contractor position, you must send your resume to hracctmgmt@calwater.com. You must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Overview

At MoFo, we couldn’t write our own success story without yours. Ready to write your story?

Join MoFo as a LATERAL CONFLICTS ANALYST on our Conflicts/New Business team!

This role can be based in San Francisco, Los Angeles, or New York.

https://www.mofo.com/offices

About The Role

Lateral Conflicts Analyst applies detailed knowledge of professional methods to produce, review, and analyze conflict of interest reports and complete the onboarding process for all attorney and paralegal hires to the firm. Ensures client service and satisfaction are achieved in all areas of responsibility.

Conflicts Analysis

Coordinate full conflicts checks for overseas paralegal and staff hires in collaboration with Resolution Attorneys and Staff Recruiting.Generate, review, and analyze conflict reports using the firm's conflicts software, protocols, and AI-assisted research tools.Conduct factual research to identify potential conflicts, including:Matter status (open/closed)Entity roles in mattersCorporate affiliate relationships using commercial databasesResearch and update corporate family trees using external databases and AI to streamline and refine findings.Independently prepare Lateral Conflict Memoranda in accordance with firm procedures.Summarize conflicts analysis results and submit recommendations to lateral attorneys for review and resolution.Coordinate with the Office of General Counsel to obtain approval of Director/Officer forms for Partners, Of Counsel, Associates, VIAs, Summer Associates, First-Year Associates, and Paralegals.Respond to conflict-related inquiries through the department hotline and prepare Business Development information-only reports.
Conflicts Operations

Create and maintain ethical walls as requested and in accordance with firm policies.Leverage current technology and AI tools to improve efficiency, collaboration, and client service.Participate in departmental initiatives and projects that enhance operational efficiency and deliver value to attorneys, clients, timekeepers, and team members.

About You

One year of conflicts or legal assistant experience (or similar law firm experience in a decision-making capacity) required.Familiarity with law firm conflicts systems and Microsoft Word preferredStrong communication, interpersonal, analytical, and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail.Ability to learn and apply conflict of interest principles, exercise sound judgment, and handle sensitive information with discretion and confidentiality.Ability to manage multiple priorities and work overtime as needed.

About Us: https://www.mofo.com/aboutInclusion + Engagement: https://www.mofo.com/community/we-at-mofoCommitment to Pro Bono: https://careers.mofo.com/careers-pro-bonoThe MoFo Foundation: https://www.mofo.com/culture/mofo-foundation

rows.title: AI Research Participant (Part-Time, Remote)
rows.descriptionText:
AI Research Participant (Part-Time, Remote)
Engramme · Remote, India
Engramme is looking for working professionals across India to participate in a paid research study on human memory and artificial intelligence. This is a flexible, ongoing opportunity designed to fit alongside your regular job. Most participants spend approximately 2–3 hours per week, with no fixed working hours.
About Engramme
Engramme is building AI models of human memory. The company spun out of Harvard University and was founded by Gabriel Kreiman, Professor at Harvard University, and Spandan Madan, IIT Delhi alumnus and Harvard PhD.
What you’ll doEngramme’s AI surfaces short summaries of events and information from your life while you work. Your primary task is to assess whether each memory is useful in its current context.You will:Review memories surfaced by Engramme’s AI.Rate whether each memory is useful or not useful.Occasionally provide written feedback, complete short surveys, or participate in research conversations.Help Engramme understand when an AI-generated memory is relevant, timely, and valuable.Provide thoughtful and sincere feedback that contributes directly to new AI research.The task is simple, but the quality of your judgment matters.
Time commitmentApproximately 2–3 hours per weekCompletely remoteNo fixed scheduleDesigned to be completed alongside a full-time jobParticipation continues month-to-month based on performance
CompensationEarn up to ₹15,000 per month, based on the amount and quality of feedback you provide.This is performance-based compensation rather than a fixed monthly salary. Consistent, thoughtful participation is required.
Who should applyThis opportunity is open to English-speaking working professionals across India, including people working in:Software and technologyEngineeringArchitecture and designLaw and consultingFinance and businessResearch and other professional fieldsYou may be a good fit if you:Are at least 18 years old.Work in an environment where most conversations and written communication are in English.Have access to a laptop and reliable internet.Can consistently provide careful, honest feedback.Are comfortable participating in an AI research study.Can work independently without a fixed schedule.Prior data-annotation or AI experience is not required.
Important conditionWe assess the quality and pattern of feedback—not only the number of ratings submitted. Automated, random, or insincere responses may result in removal from the study.This opportunity is a strong fit for people who are willing to genuinely read and evaluate each memory.
Research participationSelected applicants will complete an onboarding process and sign a research consent form before participating.
How to applyApply directly through LinkedIn, or email your resume to apply@engramme.com with the subject line:Application — AI Research ParticipantApplications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and selected participants can begin immediately.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

The Data Analyst builds and maintains the business-facing layer of HeartFlow’s data platform — analytical applications, the reporting and visualization architecture, and the semantic model definitions that serve them. This is a hands-on technical role combining application development with business intelligence architecture: work product includes code that is version controlled, peer reviewed, and deployed through continuous integration, as well as the dashboards, reports, and interfaces through which the business consumes it.

The role builds on data warehoused in Amazon Redshift, contributing to the semantic model, the reporting and visualization architecture, analytical applications, and the data quality validation and access governance around them. You will work directly with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Production, Compliance, Customer Success, and Medical Education, translating business questions into engineered, reusable data products rather than one-off deliverables.

The role spans both engineering and business fluency. The same person who writes the application code is expected to sit with the stakeholder who will use it, understand the decision it supports, and stay with it through adoption and iteration. Work ranges from a governed dashboard consumed by sales leadership to a purpose-built application that replaces a manual process outright.

Job Responsibilities:

Analytical Application Development: Design, build, and maintain business-facing analytical applications and interfaces using Python and JavaScript. Own the development lifecycle including requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.Business Intelligence & Reporting: Develop and maintain the business-facing reporting and visualization layer within Tableau — calculated field and parameter logic, dashboard design, and publishing and permissions management — building on the data sources and extract strategy designed by the Analytics Engineering function. Design dynamic and fluid visualizations for a wide range of stakeholder groups across all user levels, and create relevant measures and KPIs covering commercial performance, business performance indicators, pipeline management, and ad hoc strategic initiatives.Semantic Model Development: Author and extend Cube semantic model definitions as version-controlled code, submitted through pull request review. Implement measures, dimensions, and views consistent with the function’s modeling conventions so that business metric definitions remain centrally governed and consistently consumed.CRM Data & Reporting: Design and maintain advanced reporting and analysis on Salesforce.com (SFDC) data, applying working knowledge of SFDC reporting structure, object-field relationships, and the varied dynamics of the system. Support business users in the effective use of CRM reporting.Engineering Practice: Work within the function’s engineering operating model: Git-based version control, branching strategy, pull request authorship and review, branch protection, and CI/CD through GitHub Actions. Participate in code review as both author and reviewer.Data Quality & Stewardship: Analyze and curate varied sources of data to address key business priorities. Maintain strong data integrity including routine QC and validation across the reporting and semantic suite, contribute to automated testing and data quality validation, and identify and escalate data defects in CRM and other source data consumed by function-owned systems.Data Governance: Administer role-based access control and row-level security for function-owned reporting and application assets in accordance with company data handling policy.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with wide-ranging cross-functional teams including sales and sales leadership, operations, customer success, marketing, finance, compliance, and medical education to facilitate data-driven decisions.Ad Hoc Projects: Utilize classic SDLC and Agile processes to plan, manage, and execute ad hoc initiatives supporting various stakeholder groups.

Skills Needed:

Required:

Strong SQL, including the ability to write, optimize, and reason about queries against a cloud data warehouse and a semantic layer.Demonstrated experience writing and maintaining production code in Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language — including application development, not solely scripting or notebook work.Proven experience with full cycle dashboard development in Tableau, including calculated fields, parameters, dashboard design, and publishing and permissions, working against data sources designed by others.Strong grasp of variable and function-based calculations and the ability to design custom and dynamic metrics to shape and create various KPIs.Working knowledge of Salesforce.com (SFDC) reporting structure, object-field relationships, and the varied dynamics of the system.Git-based development workflow: branching, pull request authorship and review, and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent).Experience creating dynamic and fluid modeling and visualizations for a wide range of stakeholder groups across all user levels.Excellent communication and presentation skills appropriate to the level of audience, including the ability to elicit requirements from non-technical stakeholders.Ability to be extremely agile and deadline focused with a high degree of quality.Natural problem solver.

Preferred:

Familiarity with semantic modeling layers implemented as code (Cube, dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, or equivalent).Cloud data warehouse experience (Amazon Redshift or equivalent) as a consumer and modeler of warehoused data.Understanding of data access governance concepts, including role-based access control and row-level security.Data quality and validation practice, including QC methodology and automated testing concepts.Fundamental knowledge of object-oriented programming.Understanding of healthcare technology and commercialization.

Educational Requirements & Work Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.2+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or software development, including hands-on development work.Experience with Tableau or equivalent BI software and Salesforce.com (SFDC).Demonstrated experience writing and maintaining code in Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language.Experience working within a version-controlled development workflow and a formal code review process.Experience creating custom variable-based logic functions.Experience with semantic modeling layers implemented as code a plus.Experience with curating, modeling, and handling large-scale data sets a plus.Healthcare, medical device, or other regulated industry experience a plus.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary compensation range is $110,000 to $140,000, and bonus.

rows.title: Research Scientist, AI for Graphics and Gaming - New College Grad 2026
rows.descriptionText:
We are now seeking a Research Scientist in Generative AI for Graphics and Gaming! NVIDIA is seeking world-class deep learning researchers to build the next generation of AI for graphics and gaming—from neural rendering and real-time image/video generation to world models, AI-driven characters, and LLM-powered game experiences. Join our Applied Deep Learning Research team, renowned for revolutionizing real-time graphics with powerful AI technologies like DLSS. You’ll have access to abundant GPU compute to explore ambitious ideas and train large models at scale.

We prioritize step-change research that delivers undeniable user experience improvements, not incremental benchmark gains. You’ll work across multiple organizations at NVIDIA to drive fundamental AI research all the way into shipping products used by millions of players. Our team pushes the limits of real-time graphics and interactive storytelling experiences using the latest advances in AI. If you’re passionate about deep learning, real-time graphics, and delivering transformative technology directly into games and graphics applications, you’ll be a great fit. In this role, you will conduct cutting-edge research, train advanced models, prototype in real-time engines, and work with product, driver, and hardware teams to bring your ideas to market.

What You'll Be Doing

Research and develop AI models that improve real-time graphics quality, robustness, performance, and latency, and enable new interactive experiences such as world models, LLM-driven gameplay, and AI-driven characters.Design and run large-scale pre-training and post-training for foundation models for graphics and gaming, using NVIDIA’s GPU infrastructure for experimentation and iteration.Build and own data pipelines and datasets for foundation models and large-scale training, spanning synthetic data, in-engine captures, and real-world content.Develop and prototype models for real-time image, video, and 3D content generation in modern game engines and graphics frameworks, and create demos that clearly showcase player-visible benefits.Stay current on AI and graphics research and work with product, driver, hardware, engine, and platform teams to turn promising ideas into shipping, user-visible features.

What We Need To See

Pursuing PhD in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).Deep learning experience in image/video generation, graphics, computer vision, or related fields, with a solid understanding of core DL fundamentals.Hands-on experience training large models on multi-GPU clusters (hundreds to thousands of GPUs), building robust distributed training pipelines and debugging at scale, with strong proficiency in PyTorch required; familiarity with GPU architecture, CUDA abstractions, and efficiency techniques (e.g., distillation, pruning, low-precision training/inference) is a plus.Background in graphics—such as rendering pipelines or game engines—and experience with generative models, neural rendering, or reconstruction is a plus.Proven track record of impactful research and shipped ideas (e.g., leading publications, production features, or widely used tools), and strong communication and collaboration skills in cross-functional teams.

NVIDIA’s invention of the GPU 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company”. Do you love the challenge of pushing what's possible in realtime interactive graphics and Generative AI? If so, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 264,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

What You’ll Do

rows.title: AI Research Participant (Part-Time, Remote)
rows.descriptionText:
AI Research Participant (Part-Time, Remote)
Engramme · Remote, India
Engramme is looking for working professionals across India to participate in a paid research study on human memory and artificial intelligence. This is a flexible, ongoing opportunity designed to fit alongside your regular job. Most participants spend approximately 2–3 hours per week, with no fixed working hours.
About Engramme
Engramme is building AI models of human memory. The company spun out of Harvard University and was founded by Gabriel Kreiman, Professor at Harvard University, and Spandan Madan, IIT Delhi alumnus and Harvard PhD.
What you’ll doEngramme’s AI surfaces short summaries of events and information from your life while you work. Your primary task is to assess whether each memory is useful in its current context.You will:Review memories surfaced by Engramme’s AI.Rate whether each memory is useful or not useful.Occasionally provide written feedback, complete short surveys, or participate in research conversations.Help Engramme understand when an AI-generated memory is relevant, timely, and valuable.Provide thoughtful and sincere feedback that contributes directly to new AI research.The task is simple, but the quality of your judgment matters.
Time commitmentApproximately 2–3 hours per weekCompletely remoteNo fixed scheduleDesigned to be completed alongside a full-time jobParticipation continues month-to-month based on performance
CompensationEarn up to ₹15,000 per month, based on the amount and quality of feedback you provide.This is performance-based compensation rather than a fixed monthly salary. Consistent, thoughtful participation is required.
Who should applyThis opportunity is open to English-speaking working professionals across India, including people working in:Software and technologyEngineeringArchitecture and designLaw and consultingFinance and businessResearch and other professional fieldsYou may be a good fit if you:Are at least 18 years old.Work in an environment where most conversations and written communication are in English.Have access to a laptop and reliable internet.Can consistently provide careful, honest feedback.Are comfortable participating in an AI research study.Can work independently without a fixed schedule.Prior data-annotation or AI experience is not required.
Important conditionWe assess the quality and pattern of feedback—not only the number of ratings submitted. Automated, random, or insincere responses may result in removal from the study.This opportunity is a strong fit for people who are willing to genuinely read and evaluate each memory.
Research participationSelected applicants will complete an onboarding process and sign a research consent form before participating.
How to applyApply directly through LinkedIn, or email your resume to apply@engramme.com with the subject line:Application — AI Research ParticipantApplications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and selected participants can begin immediately.

rows.title: Triage Associate I, Platform Triage - Second Shift (Contract)
rows.descriptionText:
Latitude AI (lat.ai) is building the future of Ford’s autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.

When you join the Latitude team, you’ll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

Meet The Team

Latitude's Triage Operations team is a growing group of experts specializing in our vehicle technology and programs. We analyze large datasets from our comprehensive testing program, encompassing on-road testing, closed-course track testing, virtual simulations, and re-simulations of real-world driving logs. This analysis allows for us to identify, classify, and track vehicle performance issues and improvements. Triage Operations serves as a vital communication hub, connecting Operations, Systems Engineering, Virtual Test, and Autonomy teams to ensure a fully integrated engineering lifecycle. The insights generated directly improve our systems and machine learning algorithms, enabling us to continuously learn from challenging scenarios and enhance vehicle performance.

Expected hours of work for second shift support: 2:30pm-11:00pm ET

What You’ll Do

Evaluate vehicle test data utilizing a variety of internal tooling and logs, including analyzing detailed charts and signals within an internal software environmentUnderstand the context of an issue by examining sensor data (lidar, radar, etc.), visualizations from autonomy toolings (e.g. planned path, lane boundaries, etc.)Troubleshoot hardware and software issues of test vehicles in real time, providing live feedback and actionable steps for in-vehicle operatorsMonitor and document the context (what is happening) and identify possible cause (why is it happening, which module is responsible) of a variety of issuesWork in an operational but fast-paced environment emphasizing your attention to detailWork closely with team members and internal management to identify and escalate problems

What You'll Need To Succeed

High School Diploma or GED equivalent with two years of employment experience required. Associate or Bachelor’s Degree preferred.Flexibility in working hours and shift supportAbility to learn new tools and technologies quicklyAbility to successfully learn and execute analytical based skills to assess the cause, impact, and severity of issues while following detailed documentationStrong attention to detail with repetitive tasksExcellent communication skills to work with other team membersWillingness to quickly adapt to changes in both processes and tasksInterest and desire to work in the development of advanced driver-assist systems (ADAS)

Nice To Have

Experience working with ADAS automation testing productsExperience working in a customer facing environmentStrong Excel/Google Sheets experienceStrong Slack and Jira experienceExperience working in a software/IT, operational or STEM environmentExperience using dashboarding software such as Looker or Superset

Learn more about Latitude’s team, mission and career opportunities at lat.ai!

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

The Data Analyst builds and maintains the business-facing layer of HeartFlow’s data platform — analytical applications, the reporting and visualization architecture, and the semantic model definitions that serve them. This is a hands-on technical role combining application development with business intelligence architecture: work product includes code that is version controlled, peer reviewed, and deployed through continuous integration, as well as the dashboards, reports, and interfaces through which the business consumes it.

The role builds on data warehoused in Amazon Redshift, contributing to the semantic model, the reporting and visualization architecture, analytical applications, and the data quality validation and access governance around them. You will work directly with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Production, Compliance, Customer Success, and Medical Education, translating business questions into engineered, reusable data products rather than one-off deliverables.

The role spans both engineering and business fluency. The same person who writes the application code is expected to sit with the stakeholder who will use it, understand the decision it supports, and stay with it through adoption and iteration. Work ranges from a governed dashboard consumed by sales leadership to a purpose-built application that replaces a manual process outright.

Job Responsibilities:

Analytical Application Development: Design, build, and maintain business-facing analytical applications and interfaces using Python and JavaScript. Own the development lifecycle including requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.Business Intelligence & Reporting: Develop and maintain the business-facing reporting and visualization layer within Tableau — calculated field and parameter logic, dashboard design, and publishing and permissions management — building on the data sources and extract strategy designed by the Analytics Engineering function. Design dynamic and fluid visualizations for a wide range of stakeholder groups across all user levels, and create relevant measures and KPIs covering commercial performance, business performance indicators, pipeline management, and ad hoc strategic initiatives.Semantic Model Development: Author and extend Cube semantic model definitions as version-controlled code, submitted through pull request review. Implement measures, dimensions, and views consistent with the function’s modeling conventions so that business metric definitions remain centrally governed and consistently consumed.CRM Data & Reporting: Design and maintain advanced reporting and analysis on Salesforce.com (SFDC) data, applying working knowledge of SFDC reporting structure, object-field relationships, and the varied dynamics of the system. Support business users in the effective use of CRM reporting.Engineering Practice: Work within the function’s engineering operating model: Git-based version control, branching strategy, pull request authorship and review, branch protection, and CI/CD through GitHub Actions. Participate in code review as both author and reviewer.Data Quality & Stewardship: Analyze and curate varied sources of data to address key business priorities. Maintain strong data integrity including routine QC and validation across the reporting and semantic suite, contribute to automated testing and data quality validation, and identify and escalate data defects in CRM and other source data consumed by function-owned systems.Data Governance: Administer role-based access control and row-level security for function-owned reporting and application assets in accordance with company data handling policy.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with wide-ranging cross-functional teams including sales and sales leadership, operations, customer success, marketing, finance, compliance, and medical education to facilitate data-driven decisions.Ad Hoc Projects: Utilize classic SDLC and Agile processes to plan, manage, and execute ad hoc initiatives supporting various stakeholder groups.

Skills Needed:

Required:

Strong SQL, including the ability to write, optimize, and reason about queries against a cloud data warehouse and a semantic layer.Demonstrated experience writing and maintaining production code in Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language — including application development, not solely scripting or notebook work.Proven experience with full cycle dashboard development in Tableau, including calculated fields, parameters, dashboard design, and publishing and permissions, working against data sources designed by others.Strong grasp of variable and function-based calculations and the ability to design custom and dynamic metrics to shape and create various KPIs.Working knowledge of Salesforce.com (SFDC) reporting structure, object-field relationships, and the varied dynamics of the system.Git-based development workflow: branching, pull request authorship and review, and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent).Experience creating dynamic and fluid modeling and visualizations for a wide range of stakeholder groups across all user levels.Excellent communication and presentation skills appropriate to the level of audience, including the ability to elicit requirements from non-technical stakeholders.Ability to be extremely agile and deadline focused with a high degree of quality.Natural problem solver.

Preferred:

Familiarity with semantic modeling layers implemented as code (Cube, dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, or equivalent).Cloud data warehouse experience (Amazon Redshift or equivalent) as a consumer and modeler of warehoused data.Understanding of data access governance concepts, including role-based access control and row-level security.Data quality and validation practice, including QC methodology and automated testing concepts.Fundamental knowledge of object-oriented programming.Understanding of healthcare technology and commercialization.

Educational Requirements & Work Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.2+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or software development, including hands-on development work.Experience with Tableau or equivalent BI software and Salesforce.com (SFDC).Demonstrated experience writing and maintaining code in Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language.Experience working within a version-controlled development workflow and a formal code review process.Experience creating custom variable-based logic functions.Experience with semantic modeling layers implemented as code a plus.Experience with curating, modeling, and handling large-scale data sets a plus.Healthcare, medical device, or other regulated industry experience a plus.

A reasonable estimate of the base salary compensation range is $110,000 to $140,000, and bonus.

Heartflow is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at Heartflow, including recruitment, hiring, training, relocation, promotion, and termination.

Positions posted for Heartflow are not intended for or open to third party recruiters / agencies. Submission of any unsolicited resumes for these positions will be considered to be free referrals.

Heartflow has become aware of a fraud where unknown entities are posing as Heartflow recruiters in an attempt to obtain personal information from individuals as part of our application or job offer process. Before providing any personal information to outside parties, please verify the following: A) all legitimate Heartflow recruiter email addresses end with “@heartflow.com” and B) the position described is found on our careers site at www.heartflow.com/about/careers/.

rows.title: Operations & Impact Analyst (AI-Native)
rows.descriptionText:
Operations & Impact Analyst (AI-Native)
The Opportunity:We are an investing organization funding solutions to humanity's most pressing challenges. This has led us to focus on the inter-related areas of planet, equity, health, and poverty while also accelerating essential market infrastructure. Our dynamic approach spans diverse geographies, asset classes, structures and stages - optimizing our ability to create transformative positive impact where it is most needed.
Our investment work is a mandate of a single family office and covers all aspects of strategy, sourcing, underwriting and asset management. We are a growing team of experienced and passionate mission-aligned investment and operational professionals, advisors, and consultants.
In this phase of our organization, we're focused on accelerating our mission, building a world-class and agile team, forging trust-based partnerships with industry-leading experts, identifying high-conviction investment opportunities, and deploying capital thoughtfully.
Position Overview: As part of our planned growth, we are seeking a highly organized Operations & Impact Analyst (AI-Native) to sit at the center of a seven-person investment team deploying impact-first capital globally. This role provides real proximity to how capital allocation decisions actually get made.
This is the entry point to our operations track, focused deeply on platform management, process automation, and executive administration. Please note: investment execution (subscription docs, capital calls, etc), investment analysis and financial modeling are not part of this role and are not the primary route onwards. Our generous professional development budget deliberately supports building this operations track.
Key Responsibilities:
AI & Process ImprovementTake primary ownership of integrating AI skills and agents into manual team workflows.Test new AI capabilities, identify recurring manual friction, and build recommended automation fixes.Ensure AI-enabled workflows meet appropriate cyber and data security standards.
Investment Operations & DataMaintain pipeline and deal records to a high standard, keeping our platforms trustworthy as the ultimate source of record.Support ongoing portfolio tracking by maintaining key updates, milestones, and data used for team reporting and portfolio management.Submit and track routine investment, budget, and legal approvals through the team's technology platforms.Produce the weekly investment digest and prepare pipeline material for our weekly newsletter.Drive the NDA and NRL process with counterparties and track legal execution status.Maintain partner records.
Executive Administration & LogisticsManage calendar scheduling for specified team members, resolving conflicts and protecting time against low-value demands.Coordinate end-to-end travel, including complex itineraries and site visits, and prepare and submit monthly expenses.Manage logistics for standing meetings, offsites, and other team events.Prepare and circulate pre-reads and capture post-meeting follow-ups and outputs.Support vendor and consultant relationships and operational coordination with internal accounting, legal, and other critical stakeholders.
Core Competencies:Artificial Intelligence (AI) ; Operations Management ; Executive Administrative Assistance ; Process Automation ; Data Management ; Calendar Management ; Workflow Automation ; Project Management ; Philanthropy ; Venture Philanthropy
Qualifications:At least 2-4 years of relevant experience with an emerging competency profile focused on operational execution.We are open to people from a variety of backgrounds with transferable skills and a strongly shared mission.A passionate alignment of personal values with the firm's mission, embodying our five core values: Kind, Humble, Brave, Committed, and Continuous Learning.Adept at navigating platforms, document stores, and AI toolsets.Willingness to debate, engage in dialogue, and proactively escalate when something seems wrong, including upward.Versatile and adaptable, with strong time prioritization to allocate focus to the highest-impact work.
Salary and Benefits: The starting base salary range for this position, based in Palo Alto, is between $140,000 – $160,000 USD annually, plus a discretionary bonus. Industry-competitive compensation and benefits include an extremely attractive package:Paid health plans for employee plus qualified dependents401k matchProfessional development budget for qualified tuition reimbursement529 plan matchingCharitable giving matchingHealth & wellness program budgetHealthcare flexible spending & fertility plan
If you are interested in a mutually confidential exploratory discussion, please contact our retained recruiter Duncan, with your Resume, at:duncan@hedgeimpact.com+44 207 99 32 780+44 757 68 69 780www.hedgeimpact.com
Please also note that we always receive a very high volume and quality of interest so may only be able to respond immediately to applicants who are a particular fit for this role. If this specific opportunity is not a match with you at this time, we will be delighted to let you know about other mandates as and when appropriate.

rows.title: Data Analyst, New Grad
rows.descriptionText:
Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the way you do job search from solo, time-consuming efforts to a fast, expert-guided journey, simplifying every job search step and accelerating your route to the best job outcomes. As a Data Analyst, New Grad, you will work onsite with product, engineering, and AI teams to turn product, job market, and user data into insights that directly influence product development.
Why Join Us
